_comment: Example for psbt_accept.py. State persists in the --db file across passes (like the bot), so the skeleton is assembled once and the fee_rate need NOT be re-supplied on pass 2. fee_rate is OPTIONAL: omit for a live estimate, or pin a number to run fully offline (pinned here so the example needs no network). Use real "txid:vout" inputs so the PSBT is importable and signable. Pass 1: run with no signed_psbt -> prints the skeleton + per-participant signing indices. Sign in your wallet, paste each result into signed_psbt, re-run (same --db) for Pass 2.
